info.title: Внутренние источники — пользователи, подписки и платежи
info.description: API источников внутри Docker. Для Try it out выберите «API аналитики».

get.description: Подписки со ссылками на пользователя и тариф.
Оплаты, попытки и полные возвраты. Для BTC/USDT хранится исторический fx.

users_count.description: User count, including users with zero payments.

total_revenue_minor.description: Lifetime revenue net of refunds, in RUB minor units.

mean_ltv_minor.description: Mean LTV as a decimal string in RUB minor units, e.g. "99000.00".

median_ltv_minor.description: Median LTV as a decimal string in RUB minor units. Includes zero LTV.

SummaryValues.title: Показатели LTV
SummaryValues.description: Lifetime LTV and net revenue in RUB.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

Summary.title: Сводка LTV со временем снимка
Summary.description: LTV summary with snapshot timestamp and conversion policy.

period.description: One-based period N. Measures renewal into N+1.

eligible.description: Users who paid continuously through period N and completed it.

renewed.description: Eligible users who paid period N+1. At most one renewal per user.

cumulative_eligible.description: Original cohort members with enough observation time for period N, including earlier churn.

rate.description: renewed / eligible. Null if eligible is zero.

cumulative_rate.description: renewed / cumulative_eligible. Null if cumulative_eligible is zero.

Period.title: Одно продление подписки
Period.description: Renewal into period N+1. Ongoing periods are excluded.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

Error.title: Ошибка запроса
Error.description: Error detail and available snapshot timestamp.

price.description: Price per billing period in RUB minor units.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

cohort_size.description: Unique users in the original plan cohort before maturity filtering.

periods.description: One row per requested period. Unobserved periods have zero counts and null rates.

Retention.title: Продления выбранного тарифа
Retention.description: First chain per plan. Switching ends the prior chain. A refund removes period credit and retains cohort membership.

snapshot_id.description: Published snapshot ID. Null before first sync or in preview mode.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

last_success_at.description: Last successful sync. Null until the first success.

next_sync_at.description: Scheduled start of the next sync.

last_error.description: Last sync error. Cleared on success.

sync_in_progress.description: Whether the background sync is running.

Status.title: Состояние синхронизации
Status.description: Sync state. Failure preserves the snapshot and cursor. Response is not cached.

status.description: ok when PostgreSQL and metadata checks pass.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

Health.title: Проверка работоспособности
Health.description: Database and metadata health. Snapshot readiness is reported separately.

users_count.description: User count in the full dataset.

data_as_of.description: History cutoff, RFC3339. From 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z through the current time.

PreviewRequest.title: Параметры тестового набора
PreviewRequest.description: One JSON object, up to 4096 bytes. Unknown fields are rejected. Omitted users_count is derived from the request seed.

utm_link.description: Acquisition source. Missing UTM values are grouped under unknown.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp used by updated_since.

status.description: Subscription state. Renewal is based on payments.

started_at.description: Subscription start. Ordered by started_at, then id.

canceled_at.description: Cancellation timestamp. Null if not canceled.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp used by updated_since.

SourceSubscription.title: Подписка источника
SourceSubscription.description: Subscription linked to an existing user and plan.

amount.description: Positive int64 in source minor units. RUB has 2 decimals, BTC 8, USDT 6.

currency.description: Source currency. amount uses its minor units.

status.description: Successful charge, failed attempt or separate full refund.

period_start.description: Billing period start. Retries share the same period bounds.

period_end.description: Billing period end. Calendar boundaries clamp to the last day of the target month.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp used by updated_since.

refund_of_payment_id.description: Original succeeded payment UUID. One full refund per payment.

fx.description: Original payment rate. Required for BTC/USDT and omitted for RUB.

SourcePayment.description: Payment ledger entry. Full refunds retain the original amount, currency and FX. Invalid FX blocks snapshot publication.
SourcePayment.title: Оплата, попытка или возврат

PlanSummary.title: LTV по первому тарифу
PlanSummary.description: Lifetime revenue attributed to the first plan, including payments after a switch.

DashboardPlan.title: Тариф и его показатели
DashboardPlan.description: LTV group with plan name and billing period.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.
Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

cohort_size.description: Unique users in the original plan cohort before maturity filtering.

periods.description: One row per requested period. Unobserved periods have zero counts and null rates.

RetentionReport.title: Тарифная кривая продлений
RetentionReport.description: Renewals for one plan in the dashboard.

users_count.description: User count in the full dataset.

payments_count.description: Payment ledger count, including attempts and refunds.

succeeded_count.description: Succeeded count, including charges later refunded.

switches_count.description: Users who held more than one plan.

active_periods.description: Subscriptions with an ongoing billing period at the snapshot timestamp.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of canonical source records, as 64 hexadecimal characters.

currencies.description: Payment record counts by currency, including attempts and refunds.

Dataset.title: Паспорт набора данных
Dataset.description: Metadata for the full dataset regardless of cohort filters.

first_subscription_at.description: First subscription time. Null if no subscription exists.

first_plan_id.description: First plan ID. Empty if no subscription exists.

ltv_minor.description: Lifetime net LTV in RUB minor units.

utm_link.description: Acquisition source. Missing UTM values are grouped under unknown.

data_as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC, RFC3339. Null where allowed if no snapshot is available.

snapshot_id.description: Published snapshot ID. Null before first sync or in preview mode.

mode.description: live uses the published snapshot. preview uses seed-generated data.

selection.description: first_plan отбирает по первому тарифу. chain включает перешедших на выбранный тариф.

summary.description: Cohort totals, unaffected by users search or pagination.

timeline.description: Lifetime revenue by first-subscription cohort month.

retention.description: Plan renewal rates, including users who switched into a plan.

users_count.description: User count, including users with zero payments.

periods.description: One row per requested period. Unobserved periods have zero counts and null rates.

cohorts.description: Renewal heatmap by first subscription month. all defaults to monthly.

min_minor.description: Inclusive lower bound, in RUB minor units.

max_minor.description: Exclusive upper bound, in RUB minor units. Null for no upper bound.

users_count.description: User count, including users with zero payments.

Dashboard.title: Данные всех разделов аналитики
Dashboard.description: Dashboard metrics and user selection from one snapshot.

rub_per_unit.description: Positive decimal RUB per whole source currency unit, e.g. 1 BTC.

as_of.description: Rate timestamp at or before payment creation. Refunds retain it.

ExchangeRate.title: Исторический курс оплаты
ExchangeRate.description: Frozen historical FX quote. A full refund reuses the original quote.

method.description: Historical payment rate and full refund at the original rate.

rounding.description: Round each converted operation to RUB minor units, half away from zero.
